The '''Vestor Pulsar''' was a relatively stable [[Pulsar/Legends|pulsar]] in the [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It served as navigation beacon.
